description_en: Batch updates document tags in a data connection
description_zh: 该接口用于批量更新数据连接中的文档标签
name: BatchUpdateFileTag

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. On the <props="china">console homepage (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/knowledge-base#/home)</props><props="intl">console homepage (https://bailian.console.alibabacloud.com/#/home)</props>, click the workspace details icon in the upper-left corner to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间 ID。在百炼的<props="china">控制台首页 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/knowledge-base#/home)</props><props="intl">控制台首页 (https://bailian.console.alibabacloud.com/#/home)</props>，单击页面左上角业务空间详情图标获取
parameters.name: workspace_id

fields.help_en: The file ID in the data center. On the <props="china">Application Data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">Application Data (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props> page, click the ID icon next to the file name to obtain the ID
fields.help_zh: 数据中心的文件 ID，您可以在<props="china">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">应用数据 (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props>页面，单击文件名称旁的 ID 图标获取
fields.name: file_id

fields.help_en: The list of tags associated with the file. You can specify up to 100 tags, and the total character length of all tags cannot exceed 700
fields.help_zh: 文件关联的标签列表。最多传入100个标签，所有标签字符长度总和不能超过700
fields.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The list of documents to update
parameters.name: file_infos

parameters.help_en:
The update mode. Valid values:
APPEND: appends tags to existing tags.
OVERWRITE: overwrites existing tags
parameters.help_zh: 更新模式，仅支持APPEND（追加）和OVERWRITE（覆盖）
parameters.name: update_mode

Data.description_en: The business data returned by the operation

UpdateFileTagResultList.description_en: The list of tag update results

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned only when Success is false
ErrorCode.description_zh: 返回错误码，仅当Success为false时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only when Success is false
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误描述信息，仅当 Success 为 false 时返回

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功，可能值为：
true：成功。
false：失败
